title: processkit v0 migration supplement
description: The v1 supplement an author adds to a v0 source before migrating (v0-migration@v1 PK-MIG-015): spec.v1 in a v0 DecisionRecord, Process, or process-definition Artifact; metadata.processkit.v1 in a v0 SKILL.md. Each member of 'spec' replaces the derived value of the same v1 spec field; the values are validated with the converted item against the content-kinds@v1 schema of the target kind (PK-MIG-018).

name.description: The v1 metadata.name of the converted item. Not allowed in a Skill supplement; a Skill's name is its v0 'name'.

spec.description: v1 spec fields of the target kind (content-kinds@v1 decision-record, skill, or process-specification schema), by their v1 names.
